description:
Configure the branding for PDF invoices and packing slips. 

1. Navigate to Stores > Configuration > Sales > Sales > Invoice and Packing Slip Design.
2. Upload the logo located at '/home/ga/Documents/nestwell_logo.png' for both 'Logo for PDF Print-outs' and 'Logo for HTML Print View'.
3. Set the Address to exactly:
   NestWell Home Fulfillment
   123 Commerce Dr
   Los Angeles, CA 90001
4. Save the configuration.
5. Navigate to Sales > Orders, open the most recent pending order, and create an Invoice for it (click 'Invoice' then 'Submit Invoice').
